title: skimmia japonica f. variegata
intro: Skimmia japonica f. variegata, commonly known as the Japanese skimmia or variegated skimmia, is a variety of flowering evergreen shrub native to East Asia. This plant is known for its fragrant white flowers and attractive variegated foliage, which is often used in traditional medicine and as a decorative element in gardens. The health benefits of Skimmia japonica f. variegata include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
